title: Pushes and Pulls
seo_title: Kindergarten Pushes and Pulls Worksheets: Big Push, Small Push
standard_text: Plan and conduct an investigation to compare the effects of different strengths or different directions of pushes and pulls on the motion of an object.
meta_desc: Free kindergarten science worksheets on pushes and pulls (NGSS K-PS2-1): push or pull, big and small pushes, and which way things move. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_sub: A big push makes things go fast and far.
body_html:
How to think about it

Pushes and pulls make things move.

  • Big push: fast and far.
  • Small push: slow and not far.
  • Things move the way you push.
Example

Open a drawer. Push or pull?

It comes to you.

Answer: pull

Example

Big push or small push: which goes farther?

Big push, big move.

Answer: big push

Common mistakes

  • Thinking opening a drawer is a push.
  • Thinking a soft push goes farther.
  • Thinking a ball moves toward the hand that pushes it.

faq.q: What is the difference between a push and a pull?
faq.a: A push moves something away from you. A pull moves something toward you.

faq.q: What does a bigger push do?
faq.a: It makes the object go faster and farther.
Roll the same ball on the same floor with a small push and a big push, and count how far it goes.
